Whoever reads this, please enter the Market. I will let you have my stretching, shrinking keepsake. I'm waiting for you.

Treasure Chest Game Greg Hint.message:
By the way, if you're interested, I saw the shiniest Green Rupee somewhere in the Lost Woods. It's said to have mysterious powers... But then, it could just be another regular rupee.
Oh well.

ToT Altar as Child.message:
3 Spiritual Stones found in Hyrule... Dodongo's Cavern... Spirit Temple... Forest Temple... Ye who may become a Hero...
The path to the future is open...

ToT Altar as Adult.message: An awakening voice from the Sacred Realm will call those destined to be Sages, who dwell in the five temples. Fire Temple... Water Temple... Link's Pocket... Shadow Temple... Deku Tree... Jabu-Jabu's Belly... The awakened ones will await for the Hero to find Greg. And the evil one's key will be provided once 6 Spiritual Stones and Medallions are retrieved. And the Triforce will be granted once the evil one is defeated. Together with the Hero of Time, the awakened ones will return the light of peace to the world...
